challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

datasets.name: Chasm in Gale Crater's Interior Mound (Sakarya Vallis)
datasets.producerInstitution: University of Arizona Lunar & Planetary Laboratory / NASA JPL
datasets.fileFormat: PDS3 IMG (32-bit floating-point raster with detached or embedded ASCII PDS header)

elevation.verticalDatum: MOLA Areoid Gravitational Equipotential Surface (Mars 2000 Datum, Smith et al. 2001)

explorationRelationship.relationshipToCandidateBoxwork: The verified DTM covers a 16 km x 7 km chasm in the interior mound ~15.4 km west of the candidate Mount Sharp boxwork structures (centered near 5.06° S, 137.46° E).
explorationRelationship.usage: Primary EVA site. Block-averaged to a 10 m grid (data/terrain/sakarya-10m.*) by tools/build-terrain.mjs for slope hazards, safe-path routing and the elevation profile; the matching HiRISE orthoimage (PSP_006855_1750_RED_C_01_ORTHO browse, ~5 m/px) is the map's ground image.
